mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to a decrease in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points in a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts by more than 5% in a month signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or if the correlation between HOUST drops and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as increased production boosts corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for 3 consecutive months, signals a stable economic environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors favor equities in low-inflation scenarios.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the correlation between low CPIAUCSL and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 1% and 0.2 percentage points respectively in a month signals a strengthening consumer demand and labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the joint effect of RSAFS and UNRATE changes on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs per month for three consecutive months signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings improve.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 jobs for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or if the correlation between PAYEMS increases and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of real GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic fundamentals, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as strong economic growth supports corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or if the correlation between high GDPC1 levels and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
